daily_summary: 当日 vLLM 变更覆盖性能、正确性与平台支持多个方向：新增 FlashInfer BF16 CuTeDSL 低延迟 GEMM 后端（SM100 系）、稀疏 MLA masked MHA 扩展到 GLM-5 256 维 head、Kimi-K3 MLA 输出门融合进 QKV-A 投影等性能/特性工作；修复了 throughput 基准多模态支持、Kimi-K3 low-latency GEMM fallback 初始化、K3 DSpark 96-head 配置、KV cache 负 block 分配、fused_q_kv_rmsnorm 输出 stride、CPU offload store_threshold 计数语义、渲染器多模态预热 fork 死锁（回退）等问题；CPU 平台首次获得 MLA 端到端支持（新增 SDPA prefill 后端及 context gather/merge 的 torch fallback）；sleep-mode KV cache 分配作用域重构为仅包裹 backing allocation 并移除 post_kv_cache_wake_up 钩子；自适应验证配置校验被分离为独立校验并改为启动即抛错。

commits.comment: 修复外部已计算块分配可能请求负数 block 的问题。allocate_external_computed_blocks 在推测解码场景下，num_total_computed_tokens 对应的理论块数可能小于请求已持有的块数，cdiv(...) - len(req_blocks) 会得到负数；负值传给 get_new_blocks 会污染 block pool 空闲队列计数器。修复用 max(0, ...) 夹紧。新增回归测试验证外部计算块分配不改变 free pool 计数且请求块数不变。这是 SingleTypeKVCacheManager 基类的防御性修复，无接口变更，vllm-ascend 复用同一 KV cache 管理基础设施时自动受益。

commits.comment: 修复 fused_q_kv_rmsnorm 输出张量 stride 问题。原实现用 torch.empty_like 分配输出，当输入是宽融合投影 buffer 的列切片且 num_tokens==1 时，empty_like 会保留父张量 size-1 维度的行 stride（如 [1, 1536] 切片的 stride 为 (2112, 1)），导致 qr_out/kv_out 不是紧凑行主序；下游要求 packed row-major 的分发器（如 Kimi-K3 low-latency GEMM 的 _is_packed_row_major 检查）会拒绝该张量并静默回退到 cuBLAS，造成 decode 阶段性能损失。改为 torch.empty 分配紧凑输出，输出数值语义不变。新增 stride 回归测试。该公共算子被各平台模型复用，但改动仅为内部布局修正。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。改动是 vllm/models/common/ops/fused_qk_rmsnorm.py 的内部实现调整（empty_like → empty），不改变函数签名和输出数值，仅使输出张量变为紧凑行主序这一标准布局；Kimi-K3 low-latency GEMM 为 NVIDIA 特有路径。Ascend 若使用该公共算子，输出值不变且 packed 布局对下游 kernel 天然兼容。

NPUModelRunnerV2.initialize_kv_cache (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:216) — signature must add kv_cache_allocation_context and forward to super().initialize_kv_cache() (the MRV2 path flows through vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py → attn_utils.init_kv_cache)

NPUModelRunnerV1.initialize_kv_cache / initialize_kv_cache_tensors / _allocate_kv_cache_tensors (vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py:3714, 3790, 3961) — must accept the new param and apply the pool context around _allocate_kv_cache_tensors only, keeping bind_kv_cache outside
XliteModelRunner.initialize_kv_cache (vllm_ascend/xlite/xlite_model_runner.py:38) — must accept and forward the new param

NPUModelRunner310V2.initialize_kv_cache (vllm_ascend/_310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py:294) and NPUModelRunner310.initialize_kv_cache_tensors (vllm_ascend/_310p/model_runner_310p.py:688) — must accept and forward the new param around their _allocate_kv_cache_tensors

vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_attn_utils.py and patch/worker/patch_bind_kv_cache.py — patch attn_utils._allocate_kv_cache / bind_kv_cache consumed by the modified upstream init_kv_cache; verify they remain compatible with the new context scoping
tests/ut/worker/a2/test_worker_v1.py:417-420,460 and tests/ut/worker/a2/test_model_runner_v1_with_device.py:38-118 — assert/assume post_kv_cache_wake_up behavior and old initialize_kv_cache signature
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py: remove the `if tags is None or "kv_cache" in tags: self.model_runner.post_kv_cache_wake_up()` block in wake_up() and replace with any Ascend-specific post-wake handling (MRV2: re-init AscendBlockTables/Ascend310PBlockTables ptr/size tensors if they are stored under the sleep pool; MRV1: equivalent of the removed init_fp8_kv_scales for quantized KV — zero KV tensors and reset attention _k_scale/_v_scale to 1.0), or confirm the new upstream semantics (bookkeeping allocated outside the pool, undefined KV content overwritten by new requests) hold under CaMem. 2) In worker.initialize_from_config, stop wrapping the whole call in use_memory_pool(tag="kv_cache") and instead call self.model_runner.initialize_kv_cache(kv_cache_config, kv_cache_allocation_context=self._maybe_get_memory_pool_context(tag="kv_cache"))-style context, mirroring upstream gpu_worker.py (line ~692); note NPUWorker has no _maybe_get_memory_pool_context, so either implement it or pass allocator.use_memory_pool(tag="kv_cache") directly. 3) Update every initialize_kv_cache override (v2/model_runner.py:216, model_runner_v1.py:3714, xlite/xlite_model_runner.py:38, _310p/worker/v2/model_runner.py:294, _310p/model_runner_310p.py:688) to accept kv_cache_allocation_context: AbstractContextManager | None = None and wrap only the backing KV tensor allocation (the _allocate_kv_cache_tensors / allocate_kv_cache calls) in it, leaving bind_kv_cache and block-table bookkeeping outside the pool; forward it to super() where applicable. 4) For MRV1 (model_runner_v1.py), thread the context into initialize_kv_cache_tensors/_allocate_kv_cache_tensors. 5) Verify the Ascend-patched attn_utils._allocate_kv_cache path still runs inside the passed context via upstream init_kv_cache. 6) Update the affected unit tests (test_worker_v1.py wake_up assertions, test_model_runner_v1_with_device.py helper) to the new signature/behavior.
deep_analysis.risk: High. The upstream commit removes a public hook (post_kv_cache_wake_up) and its wake_up call site, so vllm-ascend's NPUWorker.wake_up with kv_cache tag will hard-fail with AttributeError until adapted (affects RL sleep-mode scenarios). The new scoping (pool only around backing allocation, bookkeeping outside) is a behavioral contract change: if vllm-ascend keeps wrapping the whole initialize_kv_cache, its block-table ptr/size bookkeeping (incl. 310P Ascend310PBlockTables.init_block_table_layout_tensors) stays inside the sleep pool and will be stale/undefined after wake. The removal of init_fp8_kv_scales changes quantized-KV correctness handling after level-2 sleep (fp8 k/v scales and zeroed cache); vllm-ascend must provide an Ascend equivalent or risk garbage output. CaMem pool semantics differ from CuMem, so the upstream test assumptions (undefined-remap overwrite) may not hold identically on NPU and must be validated on hardware. Signature mismatches across 5 model-runner overrides will raise TypeError if the worker is updated to pass the new keyword before the overrides are.

commits.message:
[Model Runner V2] Use MRV2 for all models by default (#53183)

Signed-off-by: Nick Hill <nickhill123@gmail.com>

affected_interfaces: vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_use_v2_model_runner.py -> vllm.config.vllm.VllmConfig.use_v2_model_runner (property already monkey-patched; semantics of the upstream default it overrides changed) and VllmConfig._validate_v1_model_runner (new method added by this commit that now runs on Ascend's default MRV1 path and must be neutralized)

vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py -> NPUModelRunnerV1 spec-decode proposers (AscendDSparkProposer, AscendDflashProposer, AscendDflash2Proposer) which run DSpark/DFlash/DFlash2 on the MRV1 runner and would be blocked by the new _validate_v1_model_runner() error
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: This commit makes MRV2 the default for ALL models in upstream (vllm/config/vllm.py), removing DEFAULT_V2_MODEL_RUNNER_ARCHITECTURES, default_v2_model_runner_architectures(), and _is_default_v2_model_runner_model(). The key Ascend impact is not the default flip itself (vllm-ascend's existing platform patch vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_use_v2_model_runner.py fully replaces the use_v2_model_runner property to return only envs.VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER, default False, so MRV1 stays the Ascend default), but the new VllmConfig._validate_v1_model_runner() path: in VllmConfig.validate(), whenever use_v2_model_runner is False (the Ascend default), it now raises ValueError for prefill context parallel, dspark, mixed sliding/full dflash, dflash2, diffusion, and batch-sharded sampling. vllm-ascend supports DSpark, DFlash, and DFlash2 on its MRV1 runner (AscendDSparkProposer/AscendDflashProposer/AscendDflash2Proposer wired into vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py), so these now fail at startup (e.g. 'Model Runner V1 does not support: dspark speculative decoding'). REQUIRED adaptation: extend vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_use_v2_model_runner.py (shared with worker via patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_use_v2_model_runner.py) to also override VllmConfig._validate_v1_model_runner with a no-op / Ascend-aware version, mirroring the existing _patched_validate_v2_model_runner (which already no-ops on 310P), so the V1-only feature gate does not raise for features the Ascend MRV1 runner actually implements. Verify PCP remains rejected on Ascend (already handled by _validate_parallel_config in vllm_ascend/platform.py:1452). Also re-check any vllm-ascend logic that branches on use_v2_model_runner (ascend_config.py:1164, worker.py, platform.py:527/831/1452, mtp.py, routed_experts.py, quantization methods) to ensure the env-controlled False default still matches MRV1 expectations after the upstream default flip. The vllm/compilation/decorators.py change (marking forward-context is_padding dynamic under torch.compile) is guarded by is_forward_context_available() and is_padding is not None, and Ascend forward contexts do set is_padding (kimi_k3.py:649, v2/model_runner.py:478), so it is safe/no-op on Ascend's eager+ACLGraph path. The vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py change (wrapping seq_lens_cpu.numpy() in gpu_sync_allowed()) is a no-op debug guard and needs no adaptation.
deep_analysis.risk: High if left unaddressed: users running DSpark (DeepSeek-V4 DSpark, Kimi-K3 DSpark, Qwen3 DSpark), DFlash, or DFlash2 (Qwen3 DFlash2) on Ascend's default MRV1 path will hit a hard ValueError during VllmConfig.validate() ('Model Runner V1 does not support: dspark speculative decoding' / 'dflash2 drafts' / 'mixed sliding/full dflash drafts'), a regression vs. the pre-commit behavior where only PCP was rejected. Adaptation risk is low-moderate: no-op'ing _validate_v1_model_runner on Ascend is consistent with the patch's existing 'defer checks to the NPU runner' philosophy, but must be paired with a test that dspark/dflash configs still validate and that genuinely unsupported combos (PCP) remain rejected. Additionally, the removed upstream symbols (_is_default_v2_model_runner_model, default_v2_model_runner_architectures) are not referenced anywhere in vllm-ascend, so no import breakage there.
